cannot extend.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"The mechanism combines 'Structural Guardrails' (Schema-First) to prevent unstructured data accumulation and 'Parallel Validation' (Shadow Mode) to quantify the integration tax before full commitment. By defining a strict JSON Schema or Protobuf contract before logging any data, the team ensures that even if the external tool's native fields are imperfect, the core experimental state remains machine-readable and migratable. Simultaneously, running a disposable local script alongside the formal tool for a fixed period (e.g., 2 weeks) allows the team to measure the actual engineering effort required to map their novel active learning workflow to the existing tool's API. If the mapping cost exceeds the threshold during Shadow Mode, the team retains the option to pivot to a custom build without having polluted their historical data, effectively decoupling the risk of 'integration tax' from the risk of 'data rot'.","premises":[],"schema":"deepreason-reasoning-envelope-v1","scope":{"covers":[],"excludes":[]},"simulation_refs":[],"uncertainties":[]}
